review.rationale: Retain the concentrated nova and meaningful high-mana reserve condition; ranged reach is deliberately sacrificed for a nearby burst.
Retain the low-HP emergency fortress: immediate recovery and excess-HP Barrier followed by Fortified with its offensive penalty.
Replace generic healing plus Haste with a controlled temporal escape: mark a moment, later return and collect staggered recovery without restoring spent AP or Movement.
Retain the phoenix burst, independent decaying Burn and removal of the caster’s Chilled state; spreading and elemental defenses remain counters.
Retain protective cleansing: recovery depends on a real affliction and the friendly gains Guard. Preserve the new concise Cleanse reader.
Retain the seven-cut single-target commitment: seven independently defended packets share one standard scaling contribution and leave little AP to escape.
Retain separate prepared firing lines: two distant chosen targets with a Mark-qualified extra packet and unusual elevation access.
Retain the close winter lock: a small surrounding formation receives damage, Root and Chilled with global timing and line-of-play counterplay.
Retain the short committed advance and separately defended three-hit rush; ordinary movement limits remain real.
Retain the life-force offense/rescue choice, but make the rescue a meaningful personal life investment into several chosen allies.
Keep the close bloodstorm and independent Bleed, but price the blood payment as a visible personal sacrifice instead of a small nominal cost.
Retain the mana-ready line attack and resource reclamation; the reserve requirement makes preparation matter.
Retain the side/rear Blindside opening; the newly released facing authority already makes it depend on a real angle.
Retain the long lightning lane and Conductive setup; leaving the lane or breaking sight is direct counterplay.
Retain deliberately chosen distributed recovery, but ensure every chosen friendly receives the cleansing/recovery rather than only a primary unit.
Frontline commitment should culminate in protection-breaking pressure, rather than echo the Lifebinder mixed-build damage/heal conversion.
Retain the named-quarry requirement, distant hunt and root; unmarked enemies cannot receive this signature.
